title: aquilegia vulgaris var. oxysepala
intro: Aquilegia vulgaris var. oxysepala, commonly known as the red columbine, is a perennial plant that belongs to the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). It is native to Europe and Asia and is known for its delicate, bell-shaped flowers that are rich in antioxidants and have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents present in Aquilegia vulgaris var. oxysepala include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
